note: The suite registry (1 Nov 2026): every program, its contract-v2 feed, and the datasets it owns. Rule: each dataset is collected once, by the program that owns it; every other program reads the owner's feed (tips, python/tic_doctrine/tips.py) instead of collecting it again. Before adding a collector to a program, check `owns` here. COP's merged snapshot (`bus`) carries every live feed in one file, refreshed every two hours, with stale feeds flagged. fresh_hours and stale_hours match COP's settings. Planned programs list what they will own, so nobody builds it twice in the meantime.

bus.note: Items keep their own `program`; COP adds `cop_program` and `cop_stale` (true when that program's feed failed and its last good items were kept).
